title: Hiring bikes for a holiday
situation: You are going to spend a week in the Lake District in England with your family next summer. You have found the advertisement below and you would like to hire bikes. Write an e-mail to the company.
situationHu: Jövő nyáron a családoddal Angliában nyaraltok, és biciklit szeretnétek bérelni; írj hivatalos e-mailt a kölcsönzőnek a hirdetés alapján.
stimulus:
GREEN WHEELS BIKE HIRE – Keswick, Lake District
City bikes, mountain bikes and e-bikes for hire
by the day or by the week
Helmets and cycling maps available
Contact us for prices and bookings!

points.text: say when you are coming and how long you would like to hire the bikes for
say how many people need bikes and what kind of bikes you would like
ask about the price and whether helmets are included

usefulPhrases.en: I am writing to ask about hiring bikes.
I saw your advertisement on the internet.
We will be in Keswick from … to …
We would like to hire four bikes for a week.
usefulPhrases.hu: Négy biciklit szeretnénk bérelni egy hétre.

usefulPhrases.en: Could you tell me how much it costs?
Are helmets included in the price?
usefulPhrases.hu: Benne van az árban a bukósisak?

usefulPhrases.en: I look forward to hearing from you.

usefulPhrases.hu: Tisztelettel: (ha nem tudod a címzett nevét)

checklistExtra: Kerültem az összevont alakokat (I'm, don't) és a baráti fordulatokat?
